useful_operation: One native CLOCK query between two CLOCK endpoint calls through the same production SDK; read-only current-process observations.

modes.1: OFF: omit only intermediate recorder stores
modes.2: ON: volatile-store useful-query snapshot to fixed actor-private buffer before end CLOCK

iteration: ON only: intermediate snapshot recorder write
same frequency/ordering/zero READ_WINDOW/checked subtraction oracle in both modes after end
same endpoint result stores outside envelope
envelope: End x0 minus start x0. Includes useful call, ordinary interval bookkeeping and partial endpoint transitions; does not isolate pure syscall or exclusive CPU time.

accounting.x2: completed execution-window ticks including transition edges and possible host stalls; not exclusive EL0 CPU time
accounting.x3: completed READ_WINDOW body ticks; checked delta exactly zero in this workload
accounting.residual: checked wall minus execution-window minus READ_WINDOW; negative residual rejects, never clamps; kernel/IRQ/scheduler/host remainder remains unattributed

sampling.repeat_unit: fresh guest boot, not individual correlated observation
sampling.stopping: Fixed campaign; no retry, history reuse, selective removal or success-based stopping; failed/unfinished attempts retained
sampling.analysis: OFF primary nearest-rank descriptive median; retain raw pairs and warmups; p95/p99 adequacy and superiority inconclusive; no exact overhead subtraction

report.success: Export schema 1 only after complete loop, then root exit 0 with acquired ownership release, frames restored and no live processes/domains
report.failure: Partial schema-0 diagnostic after failed sample plus nonzero exit; never performance data
report.integer_encoding: exact unsigned 64-bit words, no floating-point truncation

observer_scope: Incremental intermediate recorder cost only; both modes retain endpoint CLOCK probes and common oracle/result export. OFF is not instrumentation-free.
security_scope: Read-only current-process boundary, exact-source independent review, useful-query/report/termination oracle and malformed/missing evidence rejection. No invented CLOCK authorization; no malicious-kernel or fully forged custody-chain protection.
publication: Existing Arena schemas and registry; separate DEV/PROD classes; record_eligible=false; no fabricated alternative implementation or PMU/physical/REL/RES claim.
